name: sss-team-research-skill
description: Plan, write, structure and review research papers (empirical studies, systematic and literature reviews, bibliometric analyses, position papers) in the SSS team's house style, and make editable methodology, PRISMA and results figures.

interface.longDescription: SSS Team Research Skill acts as a senior co-author for researchers and students. It plans, writes and reviews every part of a paper (title, abstract, introduction, related work, methodology, results, discussion, limitations and conclusion) for four paper types: empirical studies, systematic and literature reviews, bibliometric analyses and position papers. It follows a house style distilled from published SSS team papers, plus guardrails that fix common reviewer complaints. It also makes editable figures: methodology pipelines, double-stage search and selection diagrams, PRISMA flows that check that counts add up, and publication-quality matplotlib charts. It never invents numbers or references. Missing facts become visible placeholders for the author to fill in.
defaultPrompt: Review my draft paper like a journal reviewer and fix the weakest parts.
Write the methodology for my bibliometric analysis (Scopus, VOSviewer).
Make a PRISMA diagram from my screening counts.
